scope: Allocator-domain ownership, durable useful-work liveness and local recovery. Component validation is not a completed 96MP qualification.

policy.recoveryLimit: Five consecutive comparable actual failures; peer commits permit a retry without resetting this guard.

implementation: Separate ArrayBuffer/SAB, Wasm, GPU and mapped-GPU backing ledgers from logical budget reservations. These are registered owned extents, not process RSS or physical free memory.

Durable operation tickets survive CPU admission gaps and track useful compute/IO, parent-child dependencies, waiting and recovery. Detect circular waits and exclude recovering callers without excluding independent same-owner work.
A useful peer publication permits a real allocation retry, including provider-level retry, without claiming any unobserved bytes were freed.
D2 intermediates use stable reusable Wasm arenas and bounded transferable windows; exact arithmetic and useful native output are preserved across output-allocation retries.
Active immutable dense input blocks can migrate transactionally at quiescent reader barriers; all aliases acknowledge, results/RNG persist, failures roll back, CPU leases return during storage IO.
Shared L2 read cache remains dormant until paged input actually needs it.
Automatic presentation failures, including cleanup/storage errors, preserve already committed detector ownership for update/export. Explicit cancellation still cancels.

Complete96 observation does not abort independent peers on the first detector failure. Terminal failure attempts a verified diagnostic archive, reusing an existing export after source unload and preserving primary errors.
Versioned standalone supervisor and immutable runtime snapshot run independently of chat tools. Host counters are read only at startup, first actual recovery and failure; no capacity calibration.

fullNodeSuite.initialFailures: All seven failures were absent external development assets or their missing output directory. No assertion failure or runtime correction was needed. Existing native reference assets were reconnected; source files were unchanged.

limits: A browser process kill cannot be caught by in-process JavaScript recovery.
Domain ledgers cover registered backings, not browser internals or every worker-local heap.
Diagnostic partial archives preserve completed science but do not constitute complete qualification or an implemented cross-process checkpoint reload.

The experimental dense GPU distance hook remains enabled or disabled exactly as before; its active descriptor pins are not revocable in this release. The default dense CPU path and D2 GPU execution keep their existing worker/queue ceilings.
